acceptance: The policy sets enforcement to blocking in a single reviewed change; the base policy at the time of the change is advisory, so the change itself is not blocked.
Immediately after the change, a probe pull request that adds one explanatory comment fails the comment-policy check, and one that changes no comments passes.
Strict, report, staged and CI behavior match the documentation under blocking enforcement; the whole-project strict check passes on develop.
Open pull requests that would now fail are listed and their authors told before the change lands.
The change passes an independent external soundness review with the receipt linked in the pull request body, and is merged by the repository owner.
context: Created 2026-10-02 from delivery plan v2 (/tmp/benchbox-comment-cleanup-plan-v2.md, step R2), approved by the user. Until this item lands the checker stays advisory (decision D3).
description:
The last change of the program (R2 in the delivery plan): set `enforcement` to `blocking` in quality/comment-policy.json so the checker, which landed in advisory mode and has only reported violations, starts failing pull requests that add or reword comments and docstrings. It is a one-line policy change that the advisory base does not block; the ratchet in the checker forbids moving back.

Do it only after the final whole-scope scan (comment-cleanup-final-enforcement) shows zero unapproved comments and docstrings, the exception register is merged, and no open pull request is likely to be surprised: list the open PRs that the checker would reject, tell their authors, and land the flip at a quiet time. Confirm that strict mode, report mode, the staged pre-commit hook, `make comment-policy-check` and the CI `comment-policy` job all behave as documented in docs/development/comment-policy.md under blocking enforcement. Make sure the required CI wiring for strict whole-project enforcement is in the same change.

quality/comment-policy.json is a soundness-manifest path: an external review with a `Soundness review:` section and the repository owner's manual merge are required. This item authorizes no deployment, live cloud or stress test, historical-result rewriting or write to another repository.
